title: lucuma gardneri
intro: Lucuma gardneri, commonly known as the lucuma tree or custard apple tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Sapotaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine and food in various parts of South America, particularly in Peru and Chile. The health benefits of Lucuma gardneri include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, improve digestion, and provide antioxidant properties that may help protect against certain diseases. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
